sampling: Initially four measured requests per family/mode from two fresh processes; one discarded warm-up plus two measured requests per process. For any family with an original warm-up Prefill below 2500 tok/s, one bounded matched process pair is added, retaining all original data. Counts are explicit per family/mode. Request send starts five seconds after previous DONE, before metric I/O. This idle gap is excluded from request wall time. Process pair span includes the gaps, while measured_response_wall_sum_s excludes them. Final post-DONE resync is drained before QUIT. Two separate no-pause 16K/512 smoke processes and one two-request 16K/512 numerical-check process are excluded from the primary comparison.
limitations: Synthetic 16K/2K workload; short numerical checks apply to sampled RAM-tier contributions, not full-model quality. Generated output IDs may differ across modes and repeated runs.
